title: The night-mode schedule kept on the setup pre-fill page caps nothing
claim: A pump night-mode schedule kept on the config flow's device pre-fill page leaves the plan at full nameplate power inside it, because the companion power fraction defaults to 1.0 and the setup page never offers it.
mechanism: silent_mode.compose/caps return no cap when silent_mode_power_fraction >= 1.0 (DEFAULT_SILENT_MODE_FRACTION=1.0); the setup pre-fill page writes silent_mode_windows only, so the stored schedule is inert until the user finds the fraction on the options grid page.

evidence.unit: kW change of the max planned power inside the kept 06-10 UTC window
evidence.machine: box B13, Linux x86_64 container, 4 vCPU, shared with up to two other finder seats
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats running on the box; the number is a count/plan value, immune to load

perturbation.change: config: silent_mode_power_fraction=0.6 stored beside the kept schedule; code: `silent_prefill.py --perturb` reads the fraction as 0.6 when a schedule is stored at the 1.0 default

metric_definition: Max planned kW inside the kept night window with the schedule minus without it, the window being the horizon's only cheap stretch.
phenomenon_property: A night-mode schedule the setup flow stores reduces the power the plan counts on inside it.

null_control.note: the same plan does cap once a fraction is stored, so the zero is the missing fraction

proposed_fix_scope: config_flow device_prefill (offer or default the fraction with the schedule) or silent_mode (a stored schedule with no fraction caps at a documented default).
